title: SpaceXAI Deploys Most Capable Grok 4.7 to Amazon Bedrock

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock
Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The 4.7 iteration of the Grok large language model is now available to corporate users on Amazon Bedrock and Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. This release replaces the previous Grok 4.6 version on both platforms, expanding access for enterprise developers and knowledge workers beyond SpaceXAI's own interfaces.

The model features a 500k context window and is priced at $2 for input and $6 for output per million tokens for prompts under 200k tokens on the xAI API. SpaceXAI describes Grok 4.7 as its most capable model to date, specifically optimized for coding. The model began rolling out to the Grok web and mobile apps on Oct. 1, where it serves as the base for Fast, Expert, Build, and Heavy modes.
